title: The Tomb Robber's Map
text: A dead robber lies in the barrow's passage, his skull caved in, a map clutched in his fingers. It marks a burial chamber nobody has opened. It also marks his trap, in his own hand, with a cross. He seems to have forgotten it.

options.label: The sharpest eye follows the dead man's map, minding the trap he forgot.

outcomes.text: Past his trap, into the chamber, and nothing has touched it since the day it was sealed.
His trap was not the only one.

options.label: Keep the map to sell, and let some rival walk the traps.

outcomes.text: A rival will pay well, and walk into the traps instead of you.

options.label: Burn it. Let the dead keep their things.

outcomes.text: The barrow is quieter after, as if it heard.
